pairs.subject: mcp-tools
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/_shell/nav.ts:1 The shell is React chrome (nav registry, header facts, toasts, bell, live re-read) with no tool server, client, catalog or tool-result handling; a case-insensitive grep of app/(studio)/_shell for mcp, modelcontextprotocol, tools/call, inputSchema, jsonrpc and tool_use returned no hits, so the MCP tool-protocol precondition does not hold.

pairs.subject: mcp-tools
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/read.ts:12 Agents get the ledger through a plain HTTP JSONL route (app/api/ledger, outside this context) that shares the read module, not through an MCP server, and a grep of app/(studio)/ledger for mcp, modelcontextprotocol, tools/call, inputSchema and jsonrpc found nothing, so no tool-protocol surface exists here to judge.

pairs.subject: mcp-tools
pairs.evidence: lib/foundry/extract/engine.ts:4 The extract engine is a resumable step machine driven by a CLI, a route kick and a kernel job, and it calls vision/image vendors directly; a grep of lib/foundry/extract for mcp, modelcontextprotocol, tools/call, inputSchema and tool_use found no tool protocol or function-calling surface.

pairs.subject: mcp-tools
pairs.evidence: lib/foundry/store.ts:4 The forge store, verdict log, commit plan and catalogue are a server-side disk and kernel-store layer behind the human cull, with no tool server or client; a grep of lib/foundry for mcp, modelcontextprotocol, tools/call, inputSchema and jsonrpc returned no hits.

declined.subject: mcp-tools
declined.reason: withdrawn after review: reviewer (sonnet): The anchor (handlers.ts:5) only says the routes were retired and does not show that no tool surface exists, and lib/imaging/providers/agy.ts prompts an agent CLI to call its own generate_image tool, so "publishes no tool catalog and consumes no tool results" is not cleanly supported.
